title: Delivery Policy
body:
Jumbo Sales delivers countrywide across Kenya. Because hardware and construction materials vary enormously in size, weight and handling requirements, delivery cost and timing are not fixed — they depend on several factors specific to your order.

What Affects Delivery Cost and Timing. The product type (for example, mabati sheets and steel bars require different transport than a water tank), the quantity ordered, your delivery location and distance from our dispatch point, and the overall size of your order all affect the final delivery cost and estimated delivery time. Because of this, we do not publish a fixed delivery price list — every delivery quote is calculated for your specific order.

How to Get a Delivery Quote. Message us on WhatsApp or call us with the products you want, the quantity, and your delivery location (town, area, or full address if you have one). We will confirm product availability, final pricing, and a delivery cost and estimated timeframe before you commit to the order.

Delivery Areas. We serve customers countrywide. Deliveries to major towns and areas along established transport routes are typically faster and more cost-effective; more remote locations may take longer and cost more due to transport logistics — we'll always confirm this upfront.

Receiving Your Delivery. Please inspect items on delivery where possible and raise any concerns about quantity, damage, or incorrect items with the delivery team or with us directly as soon as possible — see our Returns & Refunds policy for what happens next in that case.

Questions. For any delivery question specific to your order, contact us directly — see our Contact page for phone, WhatsApp and email details.
